description: A value-position `match` arm whose brace body holds exactly ONE expression and no `;` (`.B :> { 2 }`) is that expression — the same arm as `.B :> { 2; }` and `.B :> 2`. The expression may span lines and carry `/* */` and `//` comments. No `;` is owed (§7.2.2 rule 3: a single-expression position).
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S469 "⭐ RULED — `{ e }` in a value-position match arm is that expression" — "Allow { e } in arms too (Recommended)" ("a brace holding ONE expression is that expression") · S474 #1512 review finding 1512-1 (the bootstrap refused `.B :> { 2 }` with E-STMT-MISSING-SEMICOLON)
rationale: §18.5 (S469 r5): a value-position arm whose brace body holds exactly one expression yields that expression, with an implied `lift`. §7.2.2 rule 3 (S474): that brace is a single-expression position and takes no `;`. `g` yields 1, 2, 3; `area(_, 2)` yields 2*2*3 = 12, 2+1 = 3, 0.
